title: 第一章 边陲小城楚家子第二章 天生废骨断仙途
content_zh:
落日熔金，给云州城斑驳的城墙镀上了一层黯淡的余晖。这座蜷缩在大炎王朝西北边陲的小城，像一头疲惫的老兽，在风沙的侵蚀下，透着一股子挥之不去的暮气和衰败。空气里混杂着牲口粪便、廉价脂粉和尘土的味道，是独属于边塞小城的粗粝气息。
楚家，曾经也算云州城排得上号的家族。祖上据说出过那么一两位摸到“引气境”门槛的人物，在凡人堆里很是威风过一阵子。可传到现在这一代，家道中落得厉害，只剩下一座占地尚算宽敞、但处处透着陈旧腐朽气息的老宅，以及城外百十亩收成看老天脸色的薄田，勉强支撑着个“家族”的空架子。
楚夜就住在这座老宅最偏僻的西北角，一个独立的小院。院子不大，几间瓦房也显破败，墙皮剥落，露出里面发黄的土坯。院子里倒是干净，几垄菜地绿意葱葱，显出主人家的勤快。
此刻，夕阳的残光费力地挤进狭小的窗户，落在少年单薄的背影上。
楚夜坐在一张磨得发亮的木凳上，面前是一张同样老旧的书桌。桌上摊着一本纸页泛黄、边角卷起的《大炎基础引气诀》。他看得极慢，眉头微蹙，薄薄的嘴唇抿成一条倔强的直线。手指无意识地划过书页上那些玄奥的线条和注解，指腹传来粗糙的触感。
十五岁的年纪，身形却比同龄人瘦削许多，像一根还没完全舒展开的青竹。长期的营养不良在他脸上留下了痕迹，皮肤带着一种不健康的苍白，但那双眼睛却异常清亮，像沉在寒潭底的黑曜石，深处藏着与年龄不符的沉寂和一丝不易察觉的执拗。
“引天地之灵，汇于丹田，如丝如缕，绵绵不绝……”他低声念诵着书上的口诀，尝试着按照图示的经脉路线，想象着感应那虚无缥缈的天地灵气。
呼吸渐渐变得悠长而微弱，意识沉入一片混沌的黑暗。
没有光点，没有暖流，什么都没有。
只有一片死寂的、令人窒息的虚无。
丹田处空空荡荡，仿佛一个永远填不满的破口袋。无论他如何努力，如何集中精神，如何按照书上说的去“感应”，去“引导”，结果都是一样——冰冷，沉寂，毫无回应。
时间一点点流逝，窗外最后一点天光也被暮色吞噬。屋子里彻底暗了下来，只有他清浅而有些紊乱的呼吸声。
“呼……”一声长长的、带着浓浓疲惫和挫败的叹息，终于打破了屋内的寂静。
楚夜缓缓睁开眼，眼底最后一丝微弱的光芒也熄灭了，只剩下深潭般的沉寂。他合上那本对他而言如同天书的引气诀，动作有些僵硬。掌心下意识地摸向自己后背脊骨的位置。
那里，是楚家，乃至整个云州城都知道的“秘密”，也是他所有屈辱和困境的根源——天生混沌道骨。
可惜，在世人眼中，这非但不是绝世仙缘，反而是……废骨！
“楚夜！楚夜！你个废物死哪儿去了？还不滚出来！”一个极其刺耳、充满不耐和优越感的叫骂声，像一把生锈的钝刀子，猛地划破了小院的宁静，也狠狠扎在楚夜的心上。
楚夜的身体几不可察地绷紧了一下，放在脊骨上的手指下意识地蜷缩起来。那沉寂眼底，瞬间翻涌起压抑的怒火和屈辱，但很快，又被一种更深沉的、习惯性的麻木覆盖下去。
他站起身，动作带着一种近乎木然的平静，打开了吱呀作响的房门。
院子里，站着两个人。为首的是个穿着绸缎锦衣、腰佩玉佩、体型微胖的少年，约莫十七八岁，油光满面的脸上挂着一副毫不掩饰的轻蔑和傲慢。他叫楚河，是楚家现任家主楚雄的儿子，楚夜的堂兄。旁边跟着一个膀大腰圆、满脸横肉的家丁，正是楚河的狗腿子，楚福。

楚河手里捏着一把瓜子，一边嗑，一边把瓜子皮随意地吐在楚夜精心打理过的菜地里，眼神像打量一件垃圾。
“哟，废物，终于舍得出来了？还以为你死在屋里发臭了呢！”楚河嗤笑一声，声音拔高，刻意要让整个偏院的人都听见，“怎么？又在抱着你那本破书做梦呢？还想着引气入体？哈！省省吧！你那根破脊梁骨，是老天爷给你打的烙印！废物的烙印！懂不懂？”
楚福立刻配合地发出哄笑：“少爷说得对！天生的废柴，就该认命！躲在屋里装什么大头蒜呢？还不快滚过来，少爷找你有事！”
污言秽语像冰雹一样砸过来。楚夜垂在身侧的手，指甲深深掐进了掌心，带来一阵尖锐的刺痛。他脸上没什么表情，只是微微低着头，目光落在被楚河糟蹋的菜叶上，声音低沉而沙哑：“什么事？”
“什么事？”楚河夸张地提高了调门，把最后一把瓜子连壳带仁砸在楚夜脚下，“你还好意思问？今天城西王记药铺的刘管事来了，送这个月的份子钱！结果呢？少了足足三两银子！刘管事说，上个月你娘去抓药，赊的账还没还清！楚夜啊楚夜，你们娘俩可真行！一个病痨鬼，一个废物点心，吃我们楚家的，住我们楚家的，还敢欠债不还？当我们楚家是开善堂的啊？”
提到娘亲，楚夜猛地抬起头，那双沉寂的眼眸里瞬间爆射出骇人的光芒，死死盯住楚河：“我娘抓的药钱，我会还！”
“还？你拿什么还？”楚河被楚夜的眼神刺了一下，随即恼羞成怒，上前一步，肥胖的手指几乎戳到楚夜的鼻尖上，“就凭你？一个连引气都做不到的废物？去山里挖野菜卖吗？还是去码头扛大包？就你这小身板，扛得动一袋米吗？笑话！”
唾沫星子喷了楚夜一脸。楚河看着楚夜那张隐忍而苍白的脸，一股扭曲的快意涌上心头。他最喜欢看这个名义上的堂弟被踩在泥里的样子。
“别废话了！今天这钱，你必须给老子吐出来！”楚河恶狠狠地道，“拿不出银子也行！刘管事说了，你家那半亩靠近后山崖的薄田，正好抵债！地契呢？给老子交出来！”
那半亩薄田，是楚夜和卧病在床的母亲最后的依仗！是口粮的来源！楚夜的心猛地一沉，一股血气直冲头顶。
“不行！”楚夜的声音斩钉截铁，带着前所未有的冷硬，“那田，是我娘的命！”
“你娘的命？哈！一个病得快死的婆娘，还谈什么命？”楚河彻底撕破了脸皮，狞笑着，“楚福！给我进去搜！把地契搜出来！这废物敢拦着，就给老子往死里打！”
“是！少爷！”楚福早就等不及了，脸上露出残忍的兴奋，捏着砂锅大的拳头，狞笑着就朝楚夜身后的房门冲去。
“滚开！”楚福蒲扇般的大手带着风声，狠狠推向楚夜，想把这个碍眼的废物像扫垃圾一样扫开。这一推，他用了全力，别说楚夜这瘦弱身板，就是个壮汉也得被推个趔趄。
content_en:
The setting sun melted gold, coating the mottled walls of Yunzhou City with a dim afterglow. This small town huddled on the northwest border of the Great Yan Dynasty looked like a tired old beast, eroded by the wind and sand, revealing a lingering twilight and decay. The air is mixed with the smell of livestock manure, cheap powder and dust, a rough smell unique to a small frontier town.
The Chu family was once considered one of the top families in Yunzhou City. It is said in our ancestors that there were one or two characters who reached the threshold of the "Qi-Entraining Realm" and became very prestigious among the mortals for a while. But by the current generation, the family has fallen into serious decline. All that is left is an old house that occupies a relatively spacious area but exudes an old and decayed atmosphere, and a hundred acres of thin fields outside the city, where the harvest is as good as God's face, barely supporting the empty frame of a "family".
Chu Ye lives in the most remote northwest corner of this old house, in an independent small courtyard. The yard is not big, and the few tile-roofed houses are dilapidated, with the walls peeling off, revealing the yellowed adobe inside. The yard is quite clean, with a few ridges of green vegetable fields, showing the diligence of the owner.
At this moment, the remaining light of the setting sun struggled to squeeze through the narrow window and fell on the young man's thin back.
Chu Ye sat on a polished wooden bench, with an equally old desk in front of him. Spread on the table is a book called "Basic Qi-Entraining Techniques of Dayan" with yellowed pages and rolled-up corners. He looked very slowly, frowned slightly, and pursed his thin lips into a stubborn straight line. His fingers unconsciously traced the mysterious lines and annotations on the page, feeling a rough touch on his fingertips.
At the age of fifteen, his figure is much thinner than that of his peers, like a green bamboo that has not fully stretched out. Long-term malnutrition has left traces on his face, and his skin has an unhealthy paleness, but his eyes are exceptionally clear, like obsidian sinking at the bottom of a cold pool, with a silence that belies his age and a trace of imperceptible stubbornness hidden in the depths.
"Invite the spirits of heaven and earth to gather in Dantian, like threads, endless..." He recited the formula in the book in a low voice, tried to follow the meridian route shown in the diagram, and imagined sensing the ethereal spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
His breathing gradually became long and weak, and his consciousness sank into a chaotic darkness.
No light, no warmth, nothing.
There was just a dead, suffocating nothingness.
The Dantian was empty, like a torn bag that could never be filled. No matter how hard he tried, how he concentrated, how he "sensed" and "guided" according to the book, the result was the same - cold, silent, and no response.
Time passed little by little, and the last bit of skylight outside the window was swallowed up by the dusk. The room was completely dark, the only sound was his shallow and somewhat disordered breathing.
"Huh..." A long, tired and frustrated sigh finally broke the silence in the room.
Chu Ye slowly opened his eyes, and the last faint light in his eyes extinguished, leaving only a deep pool of silence. He closed the Qi-Entraining Technique, which was like a heavenly book to him, and his movements were a little stiff. The palm of his hand subconsciously touched the position of his back spine.
There is the "secret" known to the Chu family and even the entire Yunzhou City, and it is also the source of all his humiliation and difficulties - the innate chaos bone.
It's a pity that in the eyes of the world, this is not only not an unparalleled immortality, but also...a waste of bones!
"Chu Ye! Chu Ye! Where did you go, you loser? Come out yet!" An extremely harsh, impatience-filled and superior-sounding yell, like a rusty blunt knife, suddenly cut through the tranquility of the small courtyard, and also pierced Chu Ye's heart.
Chu Ye's body tensed almost imperceptibly, and the fingers on his spine curled up subconsciously. In those silent eyes, repressed anger and humiliation surged for an instant, but were soon covered by a deeper, habitual numbness.
He stood up, with an almost wooden calmness in his movements, and opened the creakingdoor.
In the yard, two people stood. The leader was a slightly fat young man, about seventeen or eighteen years old, wearing a satin brocade robe and a jade pendant on his waist, with an undisguised contempt and arrogance on his oily face. His name is Chu He, the son of Chu Xiong, the current head of the Chu family, and the cousin of Chu Ye. Next to him was a servant with a big body, a round waist, and a fleshy face. It was Chu He's henchman, Chu Fu.
Chu He held a handful of melon seeds in his hand and chewed them while spitting the skins of the melon seeds into the vegetable patch that Chu Ye had carefully tended. His eyes looked like he was looking at a piece of garbage.
"Hey, you trash, you finally gave it up? I thought you died in the house and stunk!" Chu He sneered, raising his voice so that everyone in the side courtyard could hear, "What? Are you dreaming about your broken book again? Are you still thinking about breathing air into your body? Ha! Save it! That broken spine of yours is the brand that God has given you! The brand of trash! Do you understand?"
Chu Fu immediately laughed in cooperation: "The young master is right! A born loser should accept his fate! Why are you hiding in the house and pretending to be a fool? Come here quickly, the young master has something to do with you!"
The obscene words came down like hailstones. The nails of Chu Ye's hand hanging by his side dug deeply into his palm, causing a sharp sting. There was no expression on his face, he just lowered his head slightly, his eyes fell on the vegetable leaves ruined by Chuhe, and his voice was low and hoarse: "What's the matter?"
"What's the matter?" Chu He exaggeratedly raised the tune and smashed the last handful of melon seeds with shells and kernels at Chu Ye's feet, "You have the nerve to ask? Manager Liu from Wangji Pharmacy in the west of the city came today to give away this month's share! The result? A full three taels of silver were missing! Liu The manager said, your mother went to get medicine last month, but she still hasn’t paid off the credit! Chu Ye, Chu Ye, you two are really good! A sick and useless person who eats from our Chu family and lives in our Chu family, how dare you not pay back the debt? "
When he mentioned his mother, Chu Ye suddenly raised his head, and his silent eyes suddenly burst into frightening light, staring at Chu He: "I will pay back the medicine money my mother caught!"
"Repay? What do you want to repay?" Chu He was pricked by Chu Ye's eyes, and then became angry. He took a step forward, and his fat fingers almost poked the tip of Chu Ye's nose, "Just you? A waste who can't even draw air? Are you going to dig wild vegetables in the mountains to sell? Or go to the dock to carry big bags? With your small body, can you carry a bag of rice? What a joke!"
Spit sprayed on Chu Ye's face. Chu He looked at Chu Ye's forbearing and pale face, and a twisted pleasure surged into his heart. What he likes most is watching his nominal cousin get trampled in the mud.
"Stop talking nonsense! You must pay me for today's money!" Chu He said fiercely, "It doesn't matter if you can't get the money! Manager Liu said that your half-acre of Susukawa farmland near the back cliff can just pay off the debt! Where is the land deed? Hand it over to me!"
That half-acre of thin farmland was the last resort for Chu Ye and his bedridden mother! It is the source of rations! Chu Ye's heart suddenly sank, and a burst of blood rushed to the top of his head.
"No!" Chu Ye's voice was decisive, with an unprecedented coldness, "That field is my mother's life!"
"Your mother's life? Ha! What's the point of talking about the life of a woman who is so sick that she's about to die?" Chu He was completely torn and grinned, "Chu Fu! Go in and search for me! Find out the land deed! If this loser dares to stop me, I'll beat him to death!"
"Yes! Master!" Chu Fu couldn't wait any longer, with cruel excitement on his face. He clenched his casserole-sized fists and rushed towards the door behind Chu Ye with a grin.
"Get away!" Chu Fu's big hand like a leaf fan made a sound as he pushed hard towards Chu Ye, trying to sweep away this unsightly piece of trash like garbage. He pushed with all his strength. Not to mention Chu Ye's frail body, even a strong man was staggered by the push.
